stdout:
Report abuse on a video. Use this tool to report abuse on a video.

Usage:
  yutu video reportAbuse [flags]

Examples:
# Report abuse on a video
yutu video reportAbuse --ids dQw4w9WgXcQ --reasonId V
# Report abuse with secondary reason and language
yutu video reportAbuse --ids dQw4w9WgXcQ --reasonId V --secondaryReasonId V1 --language en
# Report abuse with comments
yutu video reportAbuse --ids dQw4w9WgXcQ --reasonId N --comments 'Spam content'

Flags:
  -c, --comments string                 Additional comments regarding the abuse report
  -h, --help                            help for reportAbuse
  -i, --ids strings                     IDs of the videos to report abuse on
  -l, --language string                 Language that the content was viewed in
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -r, --reasonId string                 ID of the reason for reporting abuse
  -s, --secondaryReasonId string        ID of the secondary reason for reporting abuse
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
